huer

huer is a complete R client for the Philips Hue CLIP API v2 and Hue Bridge Pro local HTTPS endpoints, built on httr2, jsonlite, and cli.

Features

  • Complete CLIP API v2 & Bridge Pro Coverage: Dedicated GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE functions for all 41 CLIP v2 & Bridge Pro resource types (including Bridge Pro MotionAware motion_area_configuration, motion_area_candidate, convenience_area_motion, security_area_motion, service_group, wifi_connectivity, speaker, bell_button, contact, tamper, and camera_motion), plus generic hue_resource_*() helpers and the root GET /clip/v2/resource endpoint.
  • Discovery, Onboarding & Streaming: Local bridge discovery (hue_discover()), link-button application key generation (hue_create_app_key()), Entertainment DTLS app ID lookup (hue_get_application_id()), and real-time Server-Sent Events streaming (hue_eventstream()).
  • Tidy JSON Output: Responses are parsed via jsonlite into tibble data frames with flattened dot-separated columns and nested array list-columns that can be expanded with hue_unnest_array().
  • Structured Diagnostics: Human-readable error and partial-error messages powered by cli and httr2.

Quick Start 

library(huer)

# 1. Discover bridges on your network
bridges <- hue_discover()
ip <- bridges$internalipaddress[[1]]

# 2. Press the link button on your Hue Bridge, then generate an app key
creds <- hue_create_app_key(ip, app_name = "huer")

# 3. Configure session credentials
hue_auth(ip = ip, app_key = creds$username[[1]], verify_ssl = FALSE)

# 4. Query lights and adjust state
lights <- hue_get_lights()
hue_update_light(
  id = lights$id[[1]],
  body = hue_payload_light(on = TRUE, brightness = 80, mirek = 300)
)

# 5. Inspect all 41 supported CLIP v2 & Bridge Pro endpoints
hue_endpoints()
